## Change and rationale

Describe the reusable component, fix or chrome change and alternatives considered.

## Review evidence

- [ ] Read AGENTS.md, DESIGN.md and CONTRIBUTING.md
- [ ] Reused shared components, chrome and semantic tokens
- [ ] Updated typed contracts and representative preview fixtures
- [ ] `npm run check` and `npm run test:browser` pass
- [ ] Inspected desktop/mobile, light/dark, keyboard/focus and meaningful states
- [ ] Attached screenshots and linked exact-commit CI and playground artifact
- [ ] Included regression coverage for fixes

Maintainers review here. Do not submit a second proposal or approval to Mortar Cloud. Contributors must not approve, merge or publish their own changes.
